portal_hypertension.title: Recanalization of the Paraumbilical Vein Mimicking an Umbilical Hernia: A Case Report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Cavalcanti GA, Ferreira BA, Pereira ASF

portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension associated with chronic liver disease may lead to recanalization of the paraumbilical vein and the development of portosystemic collateral vessels, classically manifesting as caput medusae. Although this finding is uncommon in contemporary clinical practice, dilated paraumbilical collaterals may present as an umbilical protrusion and mimic an umbilical hernia. Recognition of this condition is crucial because inadvertent surgical injury to these vessels may result in severe, potentially life-threatening hemorrhage.
